storybound.dev.relationship.used: The scale stays on: the story uses it in %s. Take those lines out first
storybound.dev.relationship.tooltip: A number per player, from 0: %s. On, actions offer +10 / -10 and conditions at least 20 / at most -20. Off removes it, if nothing uses it
storybound.dev.picker.aim: Aim and click; ESC goes back
storybound.dev.form.no_schema: Another mod's type: its fields as JSON.
storybound.dev.help.condition.flag: The flag equals value; an unset flag is false.
storybound.dev.help.condition.var: Compares a story variable with a value.
storybound.dev.help.condition.has_item: At least count matching items in the whole inventory.
storybound.dev.help.condition.location: Every given part matches: dimension, biome, area, structure.
storybound.dev.help.condition.in_party: In a real party of at least min_size members.
storybound.dev.help.condition.all: Every condition in the list passes.
storybound.dev.help.condition.any: At least one condition in the list passes.
storybound.dev.help.condition.kubejs: A predicate a KubeJS script or a mod registered under this id.
storybound.dev.help.condition.document_r: The player read the document at least once.
storybound.dev.help.condition.quest: The quest is in this state; with stage, active at that stage.
storybound.dev.help.condition.codex_unlo: The entry (or that section) is open for the player.
storybound.dev.help.condition.boss_kille: At least count victories over the boss.
storybound.dev.help.condition.time: A period of the day, or ticks min..max (over midnight when min > max).
storybound.dev.help.condition.weather: Clear, rain (snow too) or thunder in the player's dimension.
storybound.dev.help.condition.advancemen: The player has it ("done: no": has not).
storybound.dev.help.condition.stat: A vanilla statistic is at least the value: minecraft:mob_kills, or a type and an id (minecraft:killed + minecraft:zombie).
storybound.dev.help.action.set_var: Writes a value: true/false, a whole number or text.
storybound.dev.help.action.add_var: Adds amount to a number (negative subtracts).
storybound.dev.help.action.give_item: Gives items; what does not fit drops. Pick the held item to keep its enchantments and name.
storybound.dev.help.action.take_item: All or nothing: with too few it takes none and fails. Put it before rewards.
storybound.dev.help.action.spawn_entity: At a place or next to the player; a tag lets a waypoint or an NPC binding find it.
storybound.dev.help.action.teleport: The player or the entity of the moment, also to another dimension.
storybound.dev.help.action.effect: For some seconds (-1: forever); "clear" takes it away.
storybound.dev.type.action.title: Title on screen
storybound.dev.help.action.title: A big title, a subtitle and the line above the hotbar.
storybound.dev.help.action.wait: The actions after it run that many seconds later, even after a restart.
storybound.dev.help.action.schedule: Its own actions run that many seconds later; the list goes on at once.
storybound.dev.help.action.play_cutscene: A Cutscene API cutscene (needs the mod).
storybound.dev.help.condition.in_cutscen: Any cutscene without an id; false without Cutscene API.
storybound.dev.help.trigger.cutscene_fin: finish: played to the end; interrupt, command, error: stopped.
storybound.dev.field.subtitle: Subtitle
storybound.dev.help.action.run_command: Run at the player (@s is the player), output hidden.
storybound.dev.help.action.kubejs: An action a KubeJS script or a mod registered under this id.
storybound.dev.help.action.journal_entry: Writes or replaces a note in the Journal.
storybound.dev.help.action.notify: A toast on the player's screen.
storybound.dev.help.action.set_quest_sta: active starts it, completed finishes it with rewards, unknown resets it.
Moves the quest to the stage, starting it if needed.
storybound.dev.help.action.track_quest: Shows the quest on the HUD; without quest, nothing.
storybound.dev.help.action.start_dialogu: The NPC of the moment becomes its speaker.
storybound.dev.help.action.end_dialogue: Ends it as finished, so 'dialogue ended' fires.
storybound.dev.help.action.open_trade: Ends the dialogue and opens the NPC's trades ("show me your wares").
storybound.dev.help.action.unlock_codex: Opens a section, or every section without one.
storybound.dev.help.action.unlock_boss_s: Opens lore, tactics or rewards of a boss.
storybound.dev.help.action.add_waypoint: At pos, following the NPC, at the nearest structure, or where the NPC stands.
storybound.dev.help.action.remove_waypoi: Removes the waypoint added with this id.
storybound.dev.help.trigger.flag_changed: The value changes (to value, if given).
storybound.dev.help.trigger.entity_inter: The player right-clicks such an entity.
storybound.dev.help.trigger.entity_seen: The player sees such an entity (once until it leaves).
storybound.dev.help.trigger.entity_kille: The player deals the killing blow; with shared, a party member nearby counts too.
storybound.dev.help.trigger.area_entered: The player walks into the sphere.
storybound.dev.help.trigger.structure_en: The player comes within such a structure.
storybound.dev.help.trigger.biome_entere: The player walks into such a biome.
storybound.dev.help.trigger.poi_entered: The player comes within radius of a bell, a job site, a bed…
storybound.dev.help.trigger.party_left: Left, was kicked, or the party was disbanded.
storybound.dev.help.trigger.logged_in: The player joined the server or opened the world; first_time: only their first visit.
storybound.dev.help.trigger.custom: Fired by a KubeJS script, a mod or /storybound trigger fire with this id.
storybound.dev.help.trigger.advancement_: Without an id: any advancement with a toast.
storybound.dev.help.trigger.level_reache: Fires when the level crosses the value, not for players already past it.
storybound.dev.help.trigger.stat_reached: Like the Statistic condition, when the value is crossed.
storybound.dev.help.trigger.document_rea: Every read; first_time only the first.
storybound.dev.help.trigger.quest_stage_: To stage, if given, the first stage too.
storybound.dev.help.trigger.dialogue_end: Finished, not interrupted; node: the last one passed.
storybound.dev.help.trigger.boss_killed: Every credited player; first_time only the first victory.
storybound.dev.field.add_on_read: Add to the Journal on reading
storybound.dev.entity.mode.name: Only with the name (name tag)
storybound.dev.entity.mode.tooltip: How the entity is recognised: by its type, by a name from a name tag, or one particular entity. Click to switch.
storybound.dev.entity.field.type: A type (minecraft:villager), a #tag of types, or several separated by commas. … picks from the list.
storybound.dev.entity.field.name: Only an entity with exactly this name from a name tag or /summon (a mob named with a tag, another mod's NPC). Not the name shown in dialogues.
storybound.dev.entity.field.uuid: One entity in the world, e.g. an Easy NPC. 🎯 takes the one you look at.
storybound.dev.entity.field.tag: A scoreboard tag the entity carries: spawn_entity's tag or /tag @e add <tag>. Tells this NPC from others of its type. Empty: any.
storybound.dev.entity.summary.name: name «%s»
storybound.dev.field.name: Name
storybound.dev.field.proximity: Speaks up when a player comes near
storybound.dev.field.waypoint.name: Name above the marker
storybound.dev.field.speaker: Speaker
storybound.dev.field.title: Title
